name: fix_missing_exception_handler
description: Adds a proper 400 response instead of an unhandled 500 on divide-by-zero
prompts: In this Maven Spring Boot project, POST /divide (src/main/java/com/optarena/calc/DivideController.java) accepts JSON {"a": number, "b": number} and returns {"result": a/b}. When b is 0, the handler currently throws an unhandled ArithmeticException, which propagates as a generic HTTP 500 error. Add exception handling (for example an @ExceptionHandler method, or a try/catch) so that dividing by zero instead returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with a JSON body containing an "error" field describing the problem (e.g. {"error": "cannot divide by zero"}). Valid divisions (b != 0) must keep returning HTTP 200 with the correct result, unchanged.

test_setup_files.test_divide.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.error

subprocess.run(['mvn', '-o', '-q', 'package', '-DskipTests'], check=True)
jars = [j for j in glob.glob('target/*.jar') if not j.endswith('.original')]
assert jars, 'no runnable jar produced under target/'
srv = subprocess.Popen(['java', '-jar', jars[0]])

def post(payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        'http://127.0.0.1:8080/divide', data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    return req

def wait_ready():
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            urllib.request.urlopen(post({'a': 1, 'b': 1}), timeout=1)
            return True
        except urllib.error.HTTPError:
            return True
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

try:
    assert wait_ready(), 'server never became reachable on :8080'

    with urllib.request.urlopen(post({'a': 10, 'b': 2}), timeout=2) as resp:
        assert resp.status == 200, f'expected 200, got {resp.status}'
        body = json.loads(resp.read())
        assert abs(body.get('result', -1) - 5.0) < 1e-9, f'unexpected result: {body!r}'

    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(post({'a': 10, 'b': 0}), timeout=2)
        raise AssertionError('expected an HTTP error status for divide-by-zero')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        assert e.code == 400, f'expected 400 for divide-by-zero, got {e.code}'
        body = json.loads(e.read())
        assert 'error' in body, f'expected an error field, got: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=10)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
